      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SlotsFree" name="Slots free?" default="Flow_4">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_ShowCourses" name="Show courses and dates">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NoSlots" name="No slots available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCourse" name="Select course">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckAccount" name="Check for existing account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountExists" name="Account exists?" default="Flow_9">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckEligibility" name="Check registration at eligible university">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Eligible" name="Registered at eligible university?" default="Flow_12">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RegisterAccount" name="Register account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RequestActivation" name="Request activation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_ActivationResponse" name="Activation response received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDef_ActivationResponse"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountJoin" name="Account available">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_LogIn" name="Log into account">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_TweetFriends" name="Tweet to friends">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteRegistration" name="Complete course registration">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvidePayment" name="Provide payment information">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_IssueTicket" name="Issue course ticket">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_TicketReceived" name="Course ticket received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Register" targetRef="Task_CheckSlots"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_CheckSlots" targetRef="Gateway_SlotsFree"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" name="Slots free" sourceRef="Gateway_SlotsFree" targetRef="Task_ShowCourses">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${slotsFree}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" name="No slots" sourceRef="Gateway_SlotsFree" targetRef="EndEvent_NoSlots"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Task_ShowCourses" targetRef="Task_SelectCourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourse" targetRef="Task_CheckAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_CheckAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountExists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountExists" targetRef="Gateway_AccountJoin">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${hasAccount}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountExists" targetRef="Task_CheckEligibility"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_CheckEligibility" targetRef="Gateway_Eligible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" name="Eligible university" sourceRef="Gateway_Eligible" targetRef="Task_RegisterAccount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${eligibleUniversity}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" name="Not eligible" sourceRef="Gateway_Eligible" targetRef="Task_RequestActivation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_RegisterAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_RequestActivation" targetRef="Event_ActivationResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Event_ActivationResponse" targetRef="Gateway_AccountJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountJoin" targetRef="Task_LogIn"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_LogIn" targetRef="Task_TweetFriends"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_TweetFriends" targetRef="Task_CompleteRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Task_CompleteRegistration" targetRef="Task_ProvidePayment"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_ProvidePayment" targetRef="Task_IssueTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Task_IssueTicket" targetRef="EndEvent_TicketReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
